title: CircuitCapabilities
description: Output schema for qx_circuit_capabilities / Engine.capabilities. Append-only.

backend.description: Name of the gate-model execution backend.

engine_version.description: Semantic version of the QuantX engine.

supported_gates.description: Gate names accepted by the circuit executor.

supported_noise_models.description: Noise model kind tokens accepted by the circuit executor.

max_qubits.description: Practical qubit limit for the current statevector path.

max_shots.description: Practical shot limit exposed for caller planning.

supports_qiskit_like.description: True when run_qiskit_like adapter is available.

supports_cirq_like.description: True when run_cirq_like adapter is available.
